purpose: y2s62: Nord2Metal only (y2s61 + one rule). A two-plane YCbCr surface of ODD width or height is never read by the GPU in place (any process): as format 500 it is converted to RGB by the CPU, as format 540 (read-only) it is served as the raw CPU copy (red Cr, green Y, blue Cb); and in MobileSlideShow every format-500 surface up to 1024x1024 is converted by the CPU ('SURF ycbcr-cpu: ...'; off with /var/db/nord2-metal/no-photos-ycbcr-cpu; photos-ycbcr-cpu still forces every size). Run ph7: the grid's 375x667 cell pictures hold real pixels (cpu-view) and the GPU's in-place conversion gave black with or without a cache flush, while the CPU converts them right. Backup Nord2Metal.pre-vt22; undo: guest-vt22-undo.sh (back to y2s61-vt21).
